Caution wisdom nahi—boldness se act chahiye.
Tumhara mindset tumhari zindagi ki disha tay karta hai.
Mindset achievement ka engine hai.
Self-discipline time ka guardian hai.
Success matlab jo chahiye wo milna.
Vinamra raho.
Har roz ek aisa kaam karo jo tumhe daraye.
"New life ke liye sirf soch kaafi nahi."
Excellence ke liye koshish karo, perfection ke liye nahi.
"Mind muscle jaisa hai."
Mindset meaning decide karta, meaning action chalati.
Goal achieve karne se zyada zaruri hai ki tum kya ban gaye.
Soch badlo, duniya badlegi.
